description: This PHP class 'SinergiWrapper' implements the 'ClientDataWrapperInterface' to wrap around Sinergi's Browser and OS detection libraries, providing methods to retrieve browser and OS information, including legacy mappings.

classes.name: SinergiWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that detects browser and OS information using Sinergi's detection library and maps them to legacy identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a user agent string.

methods.name: getSinergiBrowser
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Sinergi Browser object.

methods.name: getSinergiOs
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Sinergi OS object.

methods.name: getBrowserName
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser detected.

methods.name: getBrowserVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the browser detected.

methods.name: getOsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OS detected.

methods.name: getOsVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the OS detected.

methods.name: isMobile
methods.description: Indicates whether the OS is mobile.

methods.name: getLegacyBrowser
methods.description: Maps the browser name to a legacy ID.

methods.name: getLegacyOs
methods.description: Maps the OS name and version to a legacy ID.
